title: Generalization Analysis of Distributed Kernel-based Robust Gradient Descent Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2609.11712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the generalization performance of distributed gradient descent algorithms in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space under a robust loss function $l_{\sigma}$. By exploiting the spectral characterization of gradient descent together with the intrinsic properties of robust loss functions, we establish optimal learning rates for the distributed kernel-based robust gradient descent (DKRGD) algorithm with an appropriately chosen scale parameter $\sigma$. The proposed parameter choice of $\sigma$ simultaneously alleviates the saturation phenomenon and guarantees statistical robustness. A key technical contribution is a novel error analysis that provides substantially sharper bounds for products of operators, thereby significantly relaxing existing restrictions on the maximum number of local machines while retaining optimal learning rates. translated_title: 分布式基于核的稳健梯度下降算法的泛化分析
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在稳健损失函数 $l_{\sigma}$ 下，分布式梯度下降算法在再生核希尔伯特空间中的泛化性能。通过利用梯度下降的谱刻画以及稳健损失函数的内在性质，我们在适当选择尺度参数 $\sigma$ 的条件下，为分布式基于核的稳健梯度下降（DKRGD）算法建立了最优学习率。所提出的 $\sigma$ 参数选择方法同时缓解了饱和现象并保证了统计稳健性。一个关键技术贡献是一种新颖的误差分析，为算子乘积提供了显著更紧致的界，从而在保持最优学习率的同时，大幅放宽了现有方法对本地机器最大数量的限制。最后，我们开发了一种通信高效策略，进一步改善了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为分布式基于核的稳健梯度下降算法建立了最优学习率，通过新颖的算子乘积误差分析大幅放宽了对本地机器数量的限制，并提出了一种同时缓解饱和现象与保证统计稳健性的尺度参数选择方法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes optimal learning rates for distributed kernel-based robust gradient descent algorithms, with a novel error analysis providing sharper bounds for operator products that significantly relaxes restrictions on the number of local machines, while proposing a scale parameter choice that simultaneously alleviates saturation and guarantees statistical robustness.
